title: Etale and Zariski cohomology agree on schemes with strictly henselian local rings
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme all of whose local rings are strictly henselian [def-weil-pbc-henselian-terminology], and let $\mathcal F$ be an abelian sheaf on the small etale site $X_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves]. Let $\epsilon:X_{\Et}\to X_{\rm Zar}$ be the morphism of sites whose underlying continuous functor sends an open subscheme to the same open scheme regarded as an etale object, and whose inverse image is the exact sheaf pullback [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology], [def-weil-pbc-site-morphism-composition]. Let $\epsilon_*\mathcal F$ be its direct image, an abelian sheaf on the small Zariski site [def-sc-zariski-site], with the canonical identification $\epsilon^{-1}\epsilon_*\mathcal F\cong\mathcal F$ for this inclusion. Then for every $q\ge0$ the canonical site-cohomology pullback/comparison map $H^q(X_{\rm Zar},\epsilon_*\mathcal F)\to H^q(X_{\Et},\mathcal F)$ [lem-weil-pbc-site-cohomology-pullback], [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology], [def-sc-zariski-cohomology] is an isomorphism.
